sb.name: Caldron Magen
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.desc: If the magen dies, it disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was wearing or carrying.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The magen has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The magen makes two attacks, using Extended Fist or Acid Spittle in any combination.

actions.name: Extended Fist
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 15 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two fists.

actions.name: Acid Spittle
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Acid damage.

sb.name: Eldritch Eddy
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The eddy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eddy makes two attacks, using Searing Swipe or Arcane Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Searing Swipe
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Fire or Lightning damage (eddy's choice).

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Force damage.

reactions.name: Eldritch Overload
reactions.desc: Trigger: The eddy takes damage. Response—Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature of the eddy's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the eddy. Failure: 7 (2d6) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

sb.name: Phaerimm Elder
sb.languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The phaerimm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The phaerimm makes three Mind Lash attacks. It can replace one attack with either (A) a Vicious Stinger attack or (B) a use of Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Command|Command]] (level 3 version).

actions.name: Mind Lash
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 32 (6d8 + 4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Vicious Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 26 (4d12) Poison damage, and the target's Speed is reduced to 0 feet until the start of the phaerimm's next turn.

actions.name: Siphon Magic (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The phaerimm focuses on a magic item it can see within 10 feet. When it does, the phaerimm drains the magic item of any charges. Regardless of whether charges are drained, the phaerimm can cast [[Tools/Spells/Clairvoyance|Clairvoyance]], [[Tools/Spells/Geas|Geas]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image]], and [[Tools/Spells/Mirage Arcane|Mirage Arcane]] one additional time that day.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Command|Command]] (level 3 version), [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Clairvoyance|Clairvoyance]], [[Tools/Spells/Geas|Geas]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Mirage Arcane|Mirage Arcane]]

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: The phaerimm teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.desc: The phaerimm casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] or [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

sb.name: Phaerimm Scout
sb.languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The phaerimm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The phaerimm makes two attacks, using Stinger or Mindwarp Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

actions.name: Mindwarp Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the phaerimm's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Clairvoyance|Clairvoyance]]

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: Trigger: The phaerimm is hit by an attack roll. Response: The phaerimm halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.
